Security researchers at Eclypsium have demonstrated a hardware-level tampering technique targeting AI infrastructure.

By gaining access to management controllers or DPUs, researchers successfully altered chatbot responses on sensitive national security and health topics, highlighting deep supply chain risks in AI deployments.
